features.quote: Turn limit: 30 external turns (R1 internal reasoning tokens do not count as turns unless emitted).
Total token ceiling: 128k per run (context + completion).
Early halt: If the same (`patch fingerprint` + `test stderr` fingerprint) repeats ≥2 times, automatically terminate and flag as L minimum.
features.justification_quote: Early halt on loops … Saves ~40% of tokens on pathological loops.
